lines.1: 「Since I have the chance, I choose this crustacean!」
lines.2: 「Oh? What? Am I secretly the girl you like?」
lines.3: 「That conceited answer proves you're exactly the person I need.」
lines.4: I pulled Crab by the hand.
lines.5: 「You don't have to pull me. I'm coming with you!」
lines.6: For some reason she looked delighted and broke into a run.
lines.7: Crab and I crossed the finish line side by side.
lines.9: 「For fairness, I will check it as well.」
lines.10: Ms. Inori and the Director peered at the paper.
lines.15: 「Idiot... Don't make me say something like that.」
lines.18: For some reason, that satisfied her. Good enough.
